# Repo-owned GoogleTest snapshot

This source is a snapshot of [google/googletest](https://github.com/google/googletest) at commit `3026483ae575e2de942db5e760cf95e973308dd5`, the exact gitlink previously recorded by Enroth Continuum. On 2026-11-07, all 243 original tracked files were copied from a clean local checkout at that commit and verified against its Git blob IDs without source edits.

The original BSD-style `LICENSE` is retained in full. This provenance note is Enroth Continuum metadata, not part of the original snapshot. The project uses this optional dependency for tests through `thirdparty/CMakeLists.txt` when `OE_BUILD_TESTS=ON`; it is not an MM7 app runtime input. Other dependencies remain external until migrated separately.
